StoryDescription: A shepherd boy, a giant warrior, and a God who wins the battle — the story of David and Goliath from 1 Samuel 17, told panel by panel.
PanelImageCredit: Art coming soon — Lorraine's own artwork will appear here.
PanelText: David was the youngest son of Jesse, a shepherd boy who watched his father's sheep in the hills near Bethlehem. One day his father sent him to the army camp with bread and cheese for his older brothers, who were soldiers in King Saul's army.
